architecture: HunyuanVideo text-to-video diffusion transformer: 40 single_blocks plus 20 double_blocks with separate image and text modulation, and a VAE
execution_class: iterative diffusion denoising over video latents; compute scales with steps x frames, so it is neither prefill nor decode in the LM sense
why_it_was_open: the config is nested under hunyuan-video-t2v-720p/ where the top-level reader never looked -- and the real blocker was worse than that: the transformer is a DeepSpeed mp_rank checkpoint whose tensors live under `module`, so a state_dict lookup returned ZERO tensors from a 12.28 GiB file without raising, and the specimen measured 0.92 GiB against 13.2 on disk, a 14x undercount
structure: 13.064B matrix params, 1424 tensors across a fp8 transformer (12.28 GiB) and an fp32 VAE (0.92 GiB)
gravity_note: NATIVELY FP8 and therefore the BitNet lesson from the other direction: 87.9% of bytes are float8_e4m3fn, yet complete EBPW is 8.678, not 8. The excess is 7.0% fp32 and 5.1% bf16 -- the VAE and the norms and modulation tensors that a 'this model is 8-bit' claim would omit.
capability_note: video generation; the campaign has no verifier for it, and a perceptual one is a separate build
disposition: HARDWARE / REPRESENTATION RESEARCH SPECIMEN -- the lake's clearest natively-fp8 body and a useful control for byte-accounting claims about low-bit models; deep Gravity DEFERRED for want of a verifier
reopen: when a perceptual verifier exists, or when a native-low-bit family study needs a non-ternary member
accounting_verified: tensor bytes equal on-disk bytes to two decimals after two producer defects were fixed: a DeepSpeed container that yielded zero tensors silently, and logical bytes that double-counted a storage-aliased EMA copy by 48%.
